breakpoints.note: First project-code materialization of the attacker-controlled program-header count. The staged ELF header provides the exact `e_phnum` value later used to size `file_image`, derive the legal `phdri` extent, and decide whether a second `Elf64_Phdr` actually exists.

Root cause corresponding to the staged patch. `canUnpack()` lacks the `e_phnum < 2` rejection inserted at this site, so the witness header with `e_phnum == 1` is not rejected before later unpack logic assumes a second `Elf64_Phdr` exists.
